name: Fire Lord Azula
clause: Whenever you cast a spell while ~ is attacking, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'copy-spell', target: TargetSpec | Ref, newTargets?: boolean }  — widen `target` to accept 'triggering' / 'that' / 'target:<n>'
needs.semantics: Copy the spell a Ref names instead of requiring the effect's own target requirement. 'copy that spell' copies the triggering spell; Narset's Reversal needs the SAME single target for the copy and for the bounce, which two TargetSpecs cannot express.
needs.clause: Whenever you cast a spell while ~ is attacking, copy that spell. / Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand.
